short_caption: Two potted calatheas in purple pots on a wooden board.
literal_description: Two small calathea plants stand in glossy purple pots on a light pine board. The left plant has rounded leaves with bright magenta-pink centers and dark green margins, plus one solid dark burgundy leaf. The right plant has larger dark green-black leaves marked with thin magenta-pink stripes along the midrib and near the edges, burgundy leaf undersides, and a rolled new leaf at the center. Water droplets sit on several leaf surfaces. The board shows a dark knot and wavy grain. Behind it is a dark charcoal wall with a fine stippled texture. A stacked light-wood crate on a black frame is partly visible at the right edge. Grey carpet is visible below the board on both sides. The photo is taken from slightly above, at close range. A circular PAROSTOK logo, a 1/3 badge and social media icons are overlaid on the image.
environment: Small indoor product-photo setup: light pine board on a grey carpeted floor in front of a dark stippled charcoal wall, with a light-wood crate on a black frame at the right edge.
visual_style: photorealistic, smartphone product photo, close-up, high contrast
lighting: Hard directional warm-white light from the front right, high contrast, crisp dark shadows cast leftward and backward across the board, dark falloff on the background wall.
atmosphere: Clear indoor air with no visible fog, dust, haze or smoke. Small water droplets visible on leaves.
ambient_sound: Quiet indoor room tone with a soft, steady background hush.
